title: BNCI 2015-012 PASS2D P300 dataset
description: This dataset comprises a 9-class auditory event-related potential (ERP) paradigm designed for brain-computer interface (BCI) applications, specifically a predictive text entry system called PASS2D. Ten healthy participants performed a single session including calibration and online spelling tasks using two-dimensional auditory stimuli varying in pitch and spatial direction. The dataset includes preprocessed EEG recordings from 63 channels sampled at 250 Hz, with performance metrics averaging 0.8 characters per minute and 3.4 bits/min information transfer rate.
methods_description: Participants completed a single 3-4 hour session consisting of calibration (3 runs of 9 trials each with 13-14 pseudo-random stimulus sequences) and online spelling phases (2 runs). EEG was recorded from 63 wet Ag/AgCl electrodes in 10-20 montage at 250 Hz sampling rate using Brain Products hardware. Data were preprocessed with 0.1-250 Hz analog bandpass filtering followed by 40 Hz digital lowpass filtering, downsampled to 100 Hz, and artifact-rejected using threshold rejection (100 μV peak-to-peak). Classification employed linear Fisher discriminant analysis with shrinkage regularization on mean amplitudes from discriminative intervals (N200: 230-300 ms, P300: 350+ ms).
